subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or adopt the conflicting fork PR and then allow a narrow replacement fix against the current Telegram native approval runtime?
rationale: The issue is valid and narrow, but there is an open closing PR outside the target repo that is conflicting and targets a removed handler path, so automation should not create another fix until a maintainer decides how to handle that candidate.

options.title: Close/adopt fork, then replace
options.body: Close or explicitly supersede the conflicting fork PR, then queue a narrow current-runtime fix using the existing `delete` final-action seam.

options.title: Manually rework the fork
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to port the fork PR onto `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` and drop the unrelated docs churn.

options.title: Keep blocked on the fork
options.body: Leave the issue linked to the conflicting fork PR, accepting that no new ClawSweeper fix PR should be queued yet.

recommendation.title: Close/adopt fork, then replace
recommendation.body: Close or explicitly supersede the conflicting fork PR, then queue a narrow current-runtime fix using the existing `delete` final-action seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and adjacent approval-runtime history make this the best available routing candidate for the fork/replacement decision.
